# watchpoint_role (Resource)

A custom tenant role with a fixed permission set. The API has no in-place update for the permission list, so changing any attribute replaces the role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_role" "example" {
  name        = "Read-Only Viewer"
  description = "Can view monitors and dashboards but cannot modify anything"
  permissions = ["monitors.read", "dashboards.read", "alerts.read"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Role name (unique within the tenant).

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the role.
- `permissions` (Set of String) Permission strings granted to the role. Unordered.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Role ID.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the role is active.
- `is_system_default` (Boolean) Whether this is a built-in system-default role.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_role.example role_001
```
